text:
rachael: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands about timelines. Can we get concrete windows for: (A) API streaming canary + GA, (B) Console Optimize recommendations beta, (C) public guidance/beta for quantization and packing? Need to lock Q3 planning.

olivia (CEO): Short version: streaming canary ~6 weeks; GA contingent on canary results (expect +3-4w). Console Optimize UI beta ~9-11 weeks (staged). Quantization/packing guidance beta late-quarter. We'll post a single timeline doc with owners by EOD.

garret (Product): Note: beta = invite-only initially (internal + selected customers). Console suggestions will be behind a consent toggle. We'll gather feedback during the staged rollout.

sumi (Eng): Streaming runtime update: attention kernel regression is mostly fixed; running long perf runs now. Gating metric is p50 token latency <120ms under baseline load. If that holds through perf runs, canary goes.

priya (Optimize Eng): Backend recommend engine is ready. UI and rollout guardrails are the main outstanding work. We plan an opt-in telemetry checkbox and a telemetry retention policy to satisfy security. Beta suggestions will be non-billable.

matt (PM): Action: I'll own the consolidated timeline doc with canary dates, GA estimates, owners, and gating metrics. Tagging @sumi @priya to add metrics.

release-bot: Scheduled canary deploy: streaming-runtime-canary -> 2027-08-14T10:00Z

rachael: Two quick asks: 1) Will we have automatic fallback to quantized variants if latency spikes? 2) Will Optimize suggestions be billed during beta?

garret (Product): 1) Yes 12 rollout policy includes automatic fallback to compatible quantized or non-streaming variants on SLO breach. 2) Beta suggestions free; monetization TBD after beta.

sumi (Eng): Example feature-flag for internal canary:
```bash
export RW_FEATURE_STREAMING=1
./deploy --env canary
```

priya (Optimize Eng): We'll add a clear opt-in in Console and surface the retention/ACLs. Need Security & Legal sign-off on prompt telemetry. @lee can you confirm requirements?

lee (Security): Telemetry must be hashed/aggregated; no raw prompt storage by default. If product specifies retention windows and access controls, security can approve. Include those in the timeline doc.

morgan-marketing: I'll draft a short customer-facing note for invited beta users once dates are final. ETA 48h after timeline publish.

olivia (CEO): Thanks. @matt publish the doc and we'll announce dates in next product update. :thumbsup:

matt (PM): Done 12 draft timeline: https://go.redwood/internal/roadmap/beta-windows (internal). Please add comments.

rachael: Perfect, that helps with sprint planning. I'll coordinate quota & infra changes for canary with infra. :white_check_mark:
